title: RiskCheckCompleted
description: Published by risk-service on the `finpay.risk` topic when a risk evaluation for a customer is completed (async variant). Partitioned by customerId.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Consumers MUST deduplicate on this field (outbox redelivery / at-least-once semantics).

eventType.description: Fixed event type; matches the schema name and the stream-filterable discriminator.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

version.description: Major schema version of this event. Additive changes stay at the same major; breaking changes require a new vN/ schema.

partitionKey.description: Kafka partition key; equals the business key customerId for ordering per customer.

customerId.description: Customer the risk assessment refers to.

items.description: Identifier of the risk rule that fired.

rulesHit.description: Risk rules that contributed to the decision.
